sections.heading: Is FxPro Worth Your Money in 2026?
sections.body:
Two decades in business, four regulatory licences, and execution speeds under 12 milliseconds — FxPro has built infrastructure that most retail brokers cannot match. The Raw+ account delivers EUR/USD from 0.0 pips with a $7 round-turn commission, putting it in direct competition with Pepperstone Razor and IC Markets Raw. And cTrader availability alongside MT4 and MT5 means you are not locked into one ecosystem.

But FxPro is not trying to attract beginners. The education section is minimal compared to AvaTrade or IG. There is no copy trading built into the platform. And the 75% retail loss rate — higher than the industry average — suggests that the traders FxPro attracts are not necessarily the traders who profit. The Standard account with 1.2-pip spreads is expensive by 2026 standards, which pushes anyone serious toward Raw+ or cTrader accounts from day one.

FxPro suits the trader who has moved past the learning phase and wants legitimate ECN-grade execution without paying for features they will never use. If you want hand-holding, go elsewhere. If you want your orders filled fast and clean at institutional-grade pricing — this is a legitimate option.

sections.heading: Is FxPro Regulated? — Licence Check 2026
sections.body:
Yes — and with strong Tier-1 oversight. FxPro UK Limited is authorised and regulated by the FCA (registration 509956) with its registered office at 80 Coleman Street, London. This is a genuine City of London presence — verified at Companies House (No. 06925128) — not a virtual address. FCA regulation means FSCS coverage up to GBP 85,000, fund segregation, and negative balance protection for UK retail clients.

EU/EEA clients trade through FxPro Financial Services Ltd, regulated by CySEC (Licence 078/07) with ICF compensation up to EUR 20,000. South African clients use the FSCA-regulated entity (Licence 45052). And clients outside these jurisdictions are routed through FxPro Global Markets Ltd under the Securities Commission of The Bahamas (SCB, licence SIA-F184) — higher leverage up to 1:500 but no investor compensation scheme.

FxPro does not appear on any active FCA, CySEC, or IOSCO warning list. No major regulatory enforcement actions have been taken against any FxPro entity. The NDD (No Dealing Desk) execution model means FxPro routes orders directly to liquidity providers without taking the opposite side of your trade — reducing the conflict of interest that exists at market-maker brokers. NAFT last reviewed FxPro regulation in May 2026.

sections.heading: FxPro Spreads, Fees and Accounts — What Do You Actually Pay in 2026?
sections.body:
FxPro offers three distinct pricing models — and the difference between them is substantial. The Standard account charges zero commission but widens spreads to 1.2 pips average on EUR/USD, costing you roughly $12 per standard lot round-turn. That is expensive in 2026. The Raw+ account strips spreads to 0.0 pips and charges $3.50 per side ($7 round-turn) — directly competitive with Pepperstone Razor and IC Markets Raw. And the cTrader account offers 0.2-pip average spreads with $35 per million traded.

For anyone trading seriously, the Raw+ account is the only sensible choice. The Standard account exists for traders who want simplicity over cost efficiency — but you are paying a significant premium for that simplicity. The cTrader commission structure converts to approximately $7 per lot for standard forex positions, making it equivalent to Raw+ in cost.

Hidden fees: FxPro charges a $15/month inactivity fee after 6 months of no trading activity. Overnight swap charges apply to all positions held past 22:00 GMT. No deposit or withdrawal fees on any method — which is genuine and uncommon. The FxPro Wallet system allows internal transfers between accounts without fees or delay.

sections.heading: How Fast Can You Get Your Money Out of FxPro?
sections.body:
Deposits are instant via card or e-wallet, with zero fees across all methods. The FxPro Wallet acts as a central hub — you deposit into the Wallet, then transfer internally to your trading accounts instantly. This makes switching between MT4, MT5, and cTrader accounts frictionless.

Withdrawals are faster than most competitors. E-wallet withdrawals (Skrill, Neteller, PayPal) process same-day. Card withdrawals take 1-2 business days. Wire transfers take 1-3 business days. FxPro charges zero withdrawal fees on all methods — genuinely rare in the industry. Your bank may charge for incoming wires, but the broker absorbs its portion entirely.

First-time withdrawals require standard KYC completion — passport, proof of address. FxPro's verification process is typically fast, with most accounts approved within hours rather than days.

sections.heading: FxPro Withdrawals in 2026 — The Real Picture
sections.body:
FxPro holds a 4.5-star rating on Sitejabber from 366 reviews and consistently positive feedback across independent review platforms. Withdrawal speed is one of the most commonly praised aspects — the same-day e-wallet processing is genuine and reliable.

The positive pattern: traders on the Raw+ and cTrader accounts report smooth, fast withdrawals with minimal friction. The FxPro Wallet system simplifies the process — funds move from trading account to Wallet instantly, then from Wallet to your payment method within the stated timeframe. Most traders report receiving e-wallet withdrawals within hours, not days.

The complaint pattern: the most common negative feedback relates to account verification delays for new clients and the inactivity fee catching traders who opened accounts but stopped trading. A small number of complaints reference slippage during extreme volatility — though this is inherent to NDD execution and not a broker failing.

If a withdrawal stalls: contact support via live chat (available 24/5). FxPro's support team has a strong reputation for resolving issues quickly. For unresolved disputes, escalate to FCA (UK), CySEC (EU), or the Financial Ombudsman Service.

sections.heading: FxPro Final Verdict — Is It Worth It in 2026?
sections.body:
NAFT scores FxPro 7.8 out of 10. Regulation is strong — FCA and CySEC provide Tier-1 oversight with FSCS/ICF compensation for UK and EU clients. Execution infrastructure is genuinely impressive — sub-12ms speeds, NDD routing, and cTrader access put FxPro in the top tier for active traders. Raw+ pricing at 0.0 pips + $7 commission is directly competitive with the best ECN brokers globally.

The weaknesses are specific: the Standard account is overpriced, the inactivity fee is aggressive, education is minimal, and the 75% retail loss rate sits above average. These matter for beginners — but FxPro is not building for beginners. It is building for traders who have already lost money elsewhere and now want the infrastructure to trade properly.

If you are past the learning curve, trade actively, and want cTrader alongside MetaTrader with genuine ECN pricing — FxPro is one of the strongest options available. If you are still building your foundation, NAFT recommends starting with AvaTrade or XM for education, then graduating to FxPro when execution speed becomes the priority.
